what_happened.line: Town counsel briefed the Sewer Commission on the Open Meeting Law, covering email, serial deliberation, executive sessions, minutes and enforcement.
The commission workshopped a communications policy, including a liaison, contact with contractors, legal opinions and supervision of the business manager; no policy was adopted.
Agenda item requests will go through the chair, and a draft policy will be circulated as a Word document and return on the July agenda.
The commission left payment of the FY18 legal expense for July 10, when the amount is to be encumbered and discussed as encumbrances are finalized.
The June 12 minutes were approved as amended, and a corrected commitment figure was presented for signature after a math error.

why_it_matters: Sewer legal costs are at issue between the sewer enterprise and the general fund, so the outcome affects whether they are carried by sewer rates or by the town budget, mostly taxes.
The communications policy will set how residents' and contractors' requests reach the commission and who directs the business manager.
watch_next: July 10 meeting: encumbrance and payment of legal expenses, plus reports on irrigation meter references and grease trap rule revisions.
The draft communications policy, due to return on the July agenda.
